title: Does anyone have experience with Huawei SmartWatch 2 as a collector?
body:
Does anyone have experience with Huawei SmartWatch 2 as a collector?
Is it necessary to make a patch for the BLT?

I have set this up for my son. We have a Freestyle libre. On top of that sits an Ambrosia Bluecon device. The Bluecon converts the Libre readings from NFC to Bluetooth & sends them to Xdrip+ running on the watch. The (Android Wear 2) watch sends the data to his (Android) phone, follower (Android) phones & Nightscout in the cloud. When we first set it up it seemed to work great, but the problems arise when the watch loses bluetooth connection to the Bluecon. It's then a major hassle to get it re-connected. So until a more robust solution comes out we've stopped using it.
I prepared the attached document to help.
[BlueconLibreXdripNightscout.docx](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/files/1973624/BlueconLibreXdripNightscout.docx)

Build: OWDD.180215.018
WearOS 1.1

Android 8.0.0

@jserajlic If you are still looking for the original stock roms OWDE.180215.017 you can find here
 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TwtOBmz-01a2EjLFdFnbGi8pqOGEeOCa/view . Use img files from sawshark.zip and fastboot to flash your watch:
fastboot flash boot boot.img
fastboot flash system system.img
fastboot flash recovery recovery.img
After that apply fix-boot-security.zip and huawei-watch-2-4g-demi-update-patch. I have used twrp provided by jamorham. Both operations are successful.

Hi everyone,
since a week I'm using a Huawai 2 watch as stand-allone collector. Just out of the box. Without patching the watch! I have follwowing Build: OWDE.180926.001.A1 / Modell: LEO-DLXX
My phone is an old Huawai Y625.
I tried it several times and finally found I had to turn off the automatic update in Playstore immy after setup and then also cut Wear OS from Internet in phone settings. I'm not sure if this is really necessary, but when I tried first, the collector stopped working soon after I turned on wifi on the phone. And didn't restart collecting, even after rebooting the watch or/and phone. But when I do factory reset on the watch, it works right after installing xdrip on the watch.

Worked for me, without firmware changes, with Glimp, but not Xdrip.  Or seemed to at least.  I didn't use glimp for long due to the relative lack of features vs. xdrip.  Could other HW2 users confirm?

Guys, please help me! I have Dexcom G6, Xiaomi Redmi 6a and Huawei Watch 2 LTE with Demigod running xDrip+ v.20190518. When I make my HW2 as the collector it can't send data to my Redmi and so my Redmi can't send data to NightScout (my Heroku website) and Dexcom Share. HW2 only collects the data itself. Is there any way to fix this issue? It's needed for the kid to go school with only the HW2 and parents could get the data from HW2 from home following the Nightscout (website or xDrip follower)  on their phones.
Did you try over wifi connection. If wifi is ok then you need to check your apn setings.

I have the same issue as @psvtg. However my setup is W2 LTE, Sony X Performance phone. W2 does not work as collector in either mode for me. 'Only' mode or 'Not phone nearby' mode. Doesn't matter if it's on WiFi or 4g.

> Did you try over wifi connection. If wifi is ok then you need to check your apn setings.

I tryed that with wifi and with LTE. No difference. On my System Status page in Redmi's xDrip is automatically set 'Phone Service State: Service Stopped' when I activate Force Wear Collection Service so I think the xDrip app blocks all smartphone acttivity including recieving data from smartwatch and the smartwatch doesn't know how to push the data straight to Nightscout or Dexcom Share.

I installed web browser on my HW2 and it runs normally by wifi and LTE.

Is it possible that this issue is because of the developers' code? Or anybody's got this scheme workable?

Make sure that both enable and force are checked under android wear integration. Additionaly be sure that treatments events are not recorded in xdrip - this is causing communication problems betwean smartwatch and phone. We are useing Huawei SW2 LTE with Samsung S9 for last 3 months without any problems. Good luck
@lmiekus can you elaborate 'be sure that treatments events are not...' with a screenshot?
@lmiekus What version of xDrip are you using?

I don't have access to computer now but these are carbs or insulin entries that you can do in xdrip on your phone. For some reason they cause communication problems betwean Phone and smartwatch. If this dosen't solve your problem, try last avalible version of android wear insted of wear os.
We are useing xdrip from 13.04.2019
@lmiekus It seems your vesion from 13.04.2019 works fine! And the new versions don't have access to Wear API. Thousands hugs!
